gen-permanent-marker-work-sans: Work Sans keeps its curves open and its shapes tidy, a modern sans-serif that never crowds itself. Work Sans sits against Permanent Marker's rough, grungy hand, which is better as a shout than as paragraphs.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-bhutuka-expanded-o: Press Start 2P is pure retro fun, spaced like pinned cut-outs. It does its best work as a playful label, while BhuTuka Expanded One, a classic serif with a slow, curvy walk, carries the literary weight.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-hepta-slab: Hepta Slab stretches every word out wide, with open counters and strokes cut to one width. Press Start 2P adds a taller, pixel-flavored lowercase above it, and a modest body size lets the slab breathe.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru has a traditional editorial air, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. Kiwi Maru gets a playful retro partner in Press Start 2P, whose pinned-apart letters sit over the roomier, rounder text below.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-padyakke-expanded-: Letters spaced like pinned cut-outs, with a faint pencil-soft thinning, mark Press Start 2P as fun and retro. Padyakke Expanded One, a serif drawn as if by a fixed-width nib, supplies the pair's authority with its pitcher-mouthed c.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-stint-ultra-expand:
Authoritative and traditional, Stint Ultra Expanded floats each character apart.

Press Start 2P is best at playful, retro attention-grabbing, while Stint Ultra Expanded, a text serif with open counters leading outward, is built for steady reading.
gen-righteous-gf-hepta-slab: Loud and rounded, Righteous fills the line with bowls cut like bent steel rod. And Hepta Slab, a serif with open counters and a stretched-out look, follows with a bookish, dignified lower register.
gen-righteous-gf-kiwi-maru: Bowls that fill the line give Righteous a commanding, fun presence. Kiwi Maru follows with generous letterspace and ring-shaped o's, giving a traditional editorial pace to anything longer.
gen-righteous-gf-padyakke-expanded-one: Big, bold, bent-rod letters. Righteous leads with commanding bowls, and Padyakke Expanded One, a serif with pitcher-wide c shapes and slack, spread-out glyphs, slows everything down beneath it.
gen-righteous-gf-stint-ultra-expanded: Stint Ultra Expanded reads like a classic serif with each character floating free of the next. But the standout is how Righteous, with its commanding bowls, sets that spacious, authoritative text off against a bolder top.
